pages.excerpt: The**Ministry for Foreign and European Affairs and Trade**([Maltese](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maltese_language):*Ministeru għall-Affarijiet Barranin u Ewropej u l-Kummerċ*) is responsible for maintaining[Malta](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malta)'s[external relations](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Foreign_relations_of_Malta)and the management of its[international diplomatic missions](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_diplomatic_missions_of_Malta). The current[minister](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ministers_for_foreign_affairs_of_Malta)is Chris Fearne.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry_for_Foreign_and_European_Affairs_(Malta)#cite_note-USDOS-1)The ministry is headquartered at[Palazzo Parisio](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Palazzo_Parisio_(Valletta)), a historic building situated on Merchants Street in[Valletta](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Valletta).[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry_for_Foreign_and_European_Affairs_(Malta)#cite_note-2)[[3]](http
